title: ghinia verbenacea
intro: Ghinia verbenacea, commonly known as Indian ashwagandha or winter cherry, is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent. This plant is considered a medicinal herb, providing several health benefits, including stress relief, improved sleep, and enhanced cognitive function. Ghinia verbenacea's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, which can help in reducing anxiety and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, such as withanolides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
